direction_notes: Focal BOLD responses at the sonication focus in 3 of 6 participants at 3T (no group effect) and in one participant at 7T (caudate).
safety_notes: Transducer surface heating tested on an agar phantom in the scanner (about 1 degC rise); no safety observations in participants reported.

exposures.label: 3T: primary motor cortex hand knob, 0.5 MHz

target.label: primary motor cortex hand knob of the dominant hemisphere

timing.protocol_description: 180 cycles of the 0.5 MHz acoustic frequency were pulsed at 1 KHz (36% duty cycle); 500 cycles of the PRF delivered, a 500 ms stimulus. Event-related design: 90 stimuli of 0.5 s delivered every 6-7 TRs (12-14 s).
420 cycles of the 0.86 MHz acoustic frequency (50% duty cycle) pulsed at 1 KHz with a 500 ms duration. Block design, 5 off/on cycles, stimulation delivered every 6 TRs during on cycles.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Six neurologically healthy volunteers (20 – 36 years) were scanned
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: For the 3T experiment, we used a 0.5MHz transducer that had an active diameter of 60 mm and focal length of 55 mm
source_quotes.exposures[1].fundamental_frequency_khz: For the 7T experiment we used a 0.86 MHz focused transducer that had an active diameter of 64 mm and a focal length of 54 mm
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Channel 1 was set to deliver US at a pulse repetition frequency of 1.0 KHz, and channel 2 was set to drive the transducer at the acoustic frequency in a bursting mode, with channel 1 serving as an external trigger for channel 2.
source_quotes.exposures[1].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: For the 7T experiment, 420 cycles of the 0.86 MHz acoustic frequency (50% duty cycle) were pulsed at 1 KHz with the same 500 ms duration as above.

source_quotes.exposures[1].timing.duty_cycle_pct: For the 7T experiment, 420 cycles of the 0.86 MHz acoustic frequency (50% duty cycle) were pulsed at 1 KHz with the same 500 ms duration as above.

flags.reason: Total never stated; 6 participants at 3T and 1 volunteer at 7T given as group sizes.
Pulse duration not stated in ms; 180 cycles at 0.5 MHz and 420 cycles at 0.86 MHz stated instead. Left not_reported.
Isppa of 6 W/cm2 was set after transmission through a 6 mm fragment of human parietal bone in a water tank, not in a brain; recorded as in_situ measurement. Same value stated for both transducers.
Text states 36% for 180 cycles at 0.5 MHz and 1 KHz PRF (arithmetically 18%); recorded as stated.
Transducers not attributed to a maker in the text for the exposures; only tank hydrophone and function generator named.
